scripts.ios:init: node scripts/generate-ios.js apps/sn-demo && cd apps/sn-demo/ios && pod install && xcodegen generate --spec project.yml
scripts.ios:build: xcodebuild -workspace apps/sn-demo/ios/SnDemo.xcworkspace -scheme SnDemo -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath apps/sn-demo/ios/.build
scripts.ios:run: xcrun simctl bootstatus booted -b && xcrun simctl install booted apps/sn-demo/ios/.build/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/SnDemo.app && xcrun simctl launch booted com.solidnative.sndemo
scripts.ios:logs: xcrun simctl spawn booted log stream --style compact --level debug --predicate 'process == "SnDemo" AND (eventMessage BEGINSWITH "[SN]" OR eventMessage CONTAINS "JS Error")'
scripts.ios:dev: (yarn ios:logs &) && yarn build && yarn ios:build && yarn ios:run
